a.lede: After Ukrainian long-range strike drones targeted Russian data centers, various Russian digital services and apps went down or faced severe disruption. There's even some suggestion that online bot activity may be down, but not by as much as initial reports claimed.
a.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russian data centers, disrupting Russian apps and services

b.lede: Russian bloggers warn Russia’s hyper-centralized digital economy is vulnerable.
b.title: Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine
